options: Only the GPS track and voltage per lap
questions.explain: Blackbox is a stream of internal control loop data for post-flight analysis.

options: To the board's flash or an SD card
questions.explain: Many boards have a flash chip; others have an SD slot. It is selected in the Blackbox tab.

questions.q: What logging rate should you use for filter analysis?
questions.explain: To see motor noise and harmonics you need a high sampling rate.

questions.q: A log with more than 1% of frames lost …
options: Is more accurate than a normal log
questions.explain: Gaps corrupt the spectrum: such a log is used only for a rough picture.

questions.q: What do you compare to see whether the drone keeps up with the stick?
questions.explain: The setpoint is the desired angular rate, the gyro is the actual one. Their difference is the quality of the tune.

questions.q: Why are the first and last seconds of a log trimmed?
options: Blackbox Explorer requires it on import
questions.explain: Takeoff, landing and transients on the ground distort the noise metrics.

questions.q: blackbox_sample_rate 1/4 with an 8 kHz PID gives a log at:
questions.explain: It is a divider of the PID rate.

questions.q: How do you get the gyro before the filters in a log?
questions.explain: The gyroUnfilt field — it is needed for before/after spectra. In 4.5 debug_mode = GYRO_SCALED gave the same thing; 2025.12 does not have this mode.
